items.title_en: ‘Leaving City Tomorrow’: Startup Founder Cuts Delhi Visit Short, Says He Could ‘Smell’ Pollution
items.title_zh: “明天离开城市”：初创公司创始人缩短德里之行，称他可以“闻到”污染
items.summary_en: Tech founder, Kunal Kushwaha, who lives in London, said he could "smell and taste" pollution in Delhi. He urged people to "leave the city".
items.summary_zh: 居住在伦敦的科技创始人库纳尔·库什瓦哈 (Kunal Kushwaha) 表示，他可以在德里“闻到和尝到”污染的味道。他敦促人们“离开这座城市”。
